title: National Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) 50-State & DC Workforce Registry
description: Comprehensive, multi-source national registry of 12,211 active Certified Nurse-Midwives (CNMs) across all 50 U.S. States and the District of Columbia, linked across AMCB, CMS NPPES, and Open Payments. State Board of Nursing (BON) licensure is genuinely observed for Washington only (374 records); see docs/PROVENANCE_DEFECT_BON_LICENSE_IDENTIFIERS.md.

author.name: Dr. Tyler Muffly, MD
author.affiliation: University of Colorado School of Medicine / Health Services Research
